newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-VICENZA GO CLEAR AT TOP FOR FIRST TIME IN HISTORY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VICENZA GO CLEAR AT TOP FOR FIRST TIME IN HISTORY.

text.p: Vicenza opened up a one-point lead at the top of serie A for the first time in their 94-year history on Sunday after defeating Reggiana with two goals from Gabriele Ambrosetti.
But Vicenza's taste of glory will be short-lived if Internazionale, leaders at the start of the day, defeat reigning champions and arch-rivals Milan in their derby later on Sunday.
Vicenza, who briefly shared the first division lead in 1963 but have never enjoyed an outright lead, top the table with 20 points from 10 matches, one ahead of Bologna and two in front of Inter.

Bologna, who won their last league title in the 1963/64 season, thrashed Atalanta 3-1 at the Dall'Ara with an own goal from Davide Fortunato and second-half strikes from Russian Igor Kolyvanov and Pierpaolo Bresciani.

Juventus, who are in Tokyo for next week's Intercontinental Cup against Argentina's River Plate, lie equal fourth on 16 points with Napoli, who needed a last-minute goal from Fabio Pecchia to draw 1-1 at Cagliari.
